family.description: The Macro or A1pp domain is a module of about 180 amino acids which can bind ADP-ribose (an NAD metabolite) or related ligands. Binding to ADP-ribose could be either covalent or non-covalent [[cite:PUB00052327]]: in certain cases it is believed to bind non-covalently [[cite:PUB00052325]]; while in other cases (such as Aprataxin) it appears to bind both non-covalently through a zinc finger motif, and covalently through a separate region of the protein [[cite:PUB00052328]]. This domain is found in a number of otherwise unrelated proteins. It is found at the C-terminus of the macro-H2A histone protein 4 and also in the non-structural proteins of several types of ssRNA viruses such as NSP3 from alpha-viruses and coronaviruses. This domain is also found on its own in a family of proteins from bacteria, archaebacteria and eukaryotes. The 3D structure of the SARS-CoV Macro domain has a mixed alpha/beta fold consisting of a central seven-stranded twisted mixed beta sheet sandwiched between two alpha helices on one face, and three on the other. The final alpha-helix, located on the edge of the central beta-sheet, forms the C terminus of the protein [[cite:PUB00043976]]. The crystal structure of AF1521 (a Macro domain-only protein from Archaeoglobus fulgidus) has also been reported and compared with other Macro domain containing proteins. Several Macro domain only proteins are shorter than AF1521, and appear to lack either the first strand of the beta-sheet or the C-terminal helix 5. Well conserved residues form a hydrophobic cleft and cluster around the AF1521-ADP-ribose binding site [[cite:PUB00021744]].
family.name: Macro domain

evidence.explanation: Figure1 and Methods were inspected, including visual comparison of precursor, CPDase intermediate, Af1521 product and matched ADPr control. Product identity remains a chromatographic assignment.

UniProt, InterPro and PDB canonical sequences match over192 residues; the current Pfam interval is shorter than the experimentally studied structural module. Reference strain and unresolved vector termini are explicit.

edges.mechanism: Af1521 addition shifts the CPDase-generated intermediate to the product position in lane3, unlike the CPDase-only lane2. ADPr control lane4 contains the same two enzymes. The joint substrate/preparation condition is retained without treating CPDase and Af1521 as independently sufficient or adding unobserved catalytic intermediates.

causal_graphs.family_mapping: Af1521 reference O28751 is 192 aa, sequence version 2, exactly matching canonical PDB 2BFQ entity1. Current PF01661 is 30-155 inclusive, not the entire protein. UniProt's VC-16 taxon224325 is reference grounding; the structural source is species-level A. fulgidus taxon2234. Neither experimental strain sequence nor terminal scar was independently verified.
causal_graphs.limitations: Lane3 co-migration with ADPr in matched enzyme/buffer lane4 supports product assignment, not an independent MS/NMR structure determination. Phosphate release and yeast YBR022W activity are reported as data not shown. The long endpoint does not establish turnover kinetics, native biological role, isolated-domain sufficiency or a resolved catalytic cycle.

evidence.explanation: Retain TableI/text stoichiometry disagreement, Figure6 panel-label swap, weak rather than absent nucleotide binding, and the current Pfam boundaries that exclude D20 and Y176.
The GST-specific unwashed-NAD exception limits directness. Human MacroD2 product identification and catalytic models do not establish Af1521 chemical intermediates.

Supplementary Figure1c identifies the tested substrate domain and retains loading bands; Af1521 dose and tag state remain unresolved. Figure1d supports binding but does not specify the salt variant or display a tag-only control, so it is not another resolved mechanistic edge.

discussions.notes: Retrieve Allen2003 full construct Methods and Dani2009 supplement. Later alpha-NAD work PMID31599159 and engineered Af1521 doi10.1038/s41467-020-18981-w remain leads only, not curated from abstracts. Other family members need their own evidence assessment. Human MacroD2 product MS, isotope tracing, modeled water activation and cellular GSK3 effects do not establish Af1521 chemistry. Naming history and similarity cannot establish uniform family function. Partial scientific self-review; IN_PROGRESS.
discussions.prompt: Resolve Af1521 construct and dose details, inspect later nucleotide and substitution studies, and extend protein-specific PF01661 coverage.
discussions.rationale: Five graphs retain eight observed assay effects from three studies, not a universal macrodomain mechanism. Current Pfam boundaries, intact-protein substitutions, tag differences and free-NAD handling limit transfers. Binding, TLC conversion and demodification are separate observations, not a measured serial pathway.
